board.name: Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh (UPMSP), Prayagraj
board.summary: Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh, set up in 1921 at Prayagraj, prescribes courses and textbooks and conducts the High School (Class 10) and Intermediate (Class 12) examinations. Its 2026-27 Class 10 mathematics and science syllabi each set a 70-mark written paper with 30 marks of internal or practical assessment, and 33 to pass. The site also carries model papers, a question bank, a month-wise academic calendar, online scrutiny of answer books and the Samadhan portal.

intro: Four Uttar Pradesh cities have their own tuition-jobs pages with zones: Lucknow, Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad. Tutors living in any of them should pick their zones there. For Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut, Bareilly and the state's many other towns, this page is the way in. Put your town and nearby localities on your profile. Home requests are offered first to the tutors nearest the family, and only then to the wider zone, city and online tutors. Online lessons have no location rule, so a tutor in Gorakhpur or Jhansi can teach students elsewhere in India.

UP students may be on the UP Board, CBSE, ICSE or another board, in Hindi or English medium. Write each one you teach. UPMSP's 2026-27 Class 10 syllabi, model papers and question bank are on upmsp.edu.in, and reading the relevant one before a demo helps. Each request ends with a shortlist of two or three tutors: the parent sees the fee you have set, the first class is a free demo, and the family can switch later. Intermediate tutors should name their subjects as well, and High School tutors can add whether they help with project work.

faqs: How is UP Board Class 10 maths marked?

UPMSP's 2026-27 syllabus sets a 70-mark written paper plus 30 marks assessed at school through projects, oral questions and unit tests, with 23 plus 10 needed to pass. Check upmsp.edu.in for any update before a demo.
I live in Meerut. Can I get Noida or Ghaziabad students?

For home lessons, families are matched to tutors near them first, so Noida and Ghaziabad requests usually go to tutors there. Online lessons are not limited by distance, and a Meerut tutor can be shortlisted if the class and subject fit.
What happens when a family asks?
We shortlist two or three tutors, nearest first, then zone, city and online. The family compares fees, takes a free first class, and may switch tutor later without paying for the change.
No. Tutors who join go through an ID check: a one-time code for phone or email and a government photo ID that our team reviews before the profile goes live. How we verify tutors gives the details.
